leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a custom Vue composition function to manage session timeout logic
Initialize reactive state variables to track user activity and remaining time
Implement event listeners to detect user interactions and reset the timeout
Configure computed properties to display formatted countdown information
Integrate the session timeout hook into a Vue component and control its behavior
Manipulate the DOM to show/hide timeout warnings based on session state
Apply the session timeout mechanism to protect sensitive application routes
